question: For each course offered by a degree-granting department in the School of Engineering, except for the Electrical Engineering and Computer Science department, what is the course key, course name, department name, and the number of catalog subjects and the total units for those subjects in the 2007 academic year? Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT 
    scd.COURSE AS course_key,
    scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS course_name,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_catalog_subjects,
    SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units
FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION scd
JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'
  AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
  AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
  AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007'
GROUP BY 
    scd.COURSE,
    scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION,
    sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME
